summary.text: Greg Nance is a Democratic member of the Washington House of Representatives, representing District 23-Position 2, and is on the ballot for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
The Kitsap County Board of Commissioners appointed him to the seat on September 18, 2023, and his career has centered on nonprofit work and youth mental health advocacy.

paragraphs.text: Nance graduated from Bainbridge High School in 2007, earned a bachelor's degree in political science from the University of Chicago in 2011 and a master's degree in management from the University of Cambridge in 2012.
He co-founded Moneythink and has served as its chairman, and has served on the boards of Kitsap Mental Health Services and MakerGirl.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, Nance said he grew up in Kitsap County, sits on the House Transportation Committee and co-chairs the Maritime Caucus.
He said that he and colleagues helped secure nearly $1 billion for ferry construction, maintenance and workforce, and that he secured $42 million to modernize West Sound Tech.
